session_flow: Raw passwords live ONLY in request.session['credential_slip_<pk>']. UserCreateView stores the form password under that key and redirects to credential_slip. CredentialBatchView.post resets passwords (secrets-based _random_password + user.set_password + save) for all TEACHER (group=staff) or STUDENT (group=students) users in request.school, clears stale slip keys first, stores new keys, redirects to credential_batch_print. CredentialSlipView.get POPS the key (refresh/later visit shows expired message). Batch print page renders one card per user whose key exists. All three views use RoleRequiredMixin with allowed_roles=[Roles.ADMIN]. No session expiry config touched.
